resources.string: HaptiMap guides you with vibrations as you walk. It needs precise location to know when to turn.
Without location, HaptiMap can\'t guide you. You can allow it at any time.
Location access is blocked. Turn it on in the app settings.
Approximate location isn\'t enough to detect each turn. Allow precise location.
Approximate location isn\'t enough. Turn on precise location in the app settings.
Two long pulses. Turn left at the next turn.
Three short, quick pulses. Turn right at the next turn.
One soft pulse. Keep going straight.
Pulses that grow stronger. The turn is here: take it now, the way the last pattern said.
One long, strong pulse. You\'ve left the route: head back, or wait for a new one.
A long pulse and two taps. You\'ve arrived.
